traits.stamens.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010) pp. 34, 362: the euasterids (the lamiids among them) are K5 [C(5) A5] G(2), one whorl of five stamens borne on the corolla tube, alternating with its lobes; four where the flower is four-merous. Families with two lips and four or two stamens state their own.

traits.carpels.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010) pp. 34, 361-363: two joined carpels in the euasterid plan K5 [C(5) A5] G(2).
